data.content_ref: inline:SRC_03 asserts 'Separation is necessary because single-engine verification is fundamentally a measure of self-consistency,' but its own countercondition concedes a case where single-engine verification can shift the truth-source to symbolic execution. By admitting an executable-sandbox countercondition under 'observation,' the target's necessity claim is no longer unconditional — it acknowledges a mechanism by which the same engine can obtain an external truth-source rather than merely self-consistency. Yet the claim and mechanism still assert unconditional necessity (perfect correlation of error terms) without reconciling how the conceded execution-based pathway leaves self-consistency as the only thing measured.
